name: INTERIOR OF A BOAT CABIN
text: The wooden walls of this small cabin are lined
with fishing gear and lit by flickering
lanterns. A small wood stove provides heat
against the damp air.

name: SINGLE BED WITH BLANKET
text: A narrow cot is tucked against the wall,
covered with a thick, patterned wool blanket.
It looks like a cozy place to rest after a
long day on the water.

name: OPEN HATCHWAY TO WATER
text: Wooden stairs lead down into a dark opening in
the floor, revealing the water lapping below.
The boards around the edge are slick with
moisture.

name: STACKED WOODEN FISH CRATES
text: Several sturdy wooden boxes are piled up,
filled to the brim with a recent catch. The
fish inside are packed tightly, scales
shimmering slightly in the low light.

name: TALL FISH CRATE
text: This wooden crate is stacked vertically,
packed full of small, silvery fish. A length
of rope trails from the bottom edge onto the
floor.

name: SQUARE FISH CRATE
text: Another solid wooden box holds a jumble of
medium-sized fish. The catch looks fresh,
ready to be processed or traded.

name: FISH CRATE WITH NET
text: This crate is partially covered by a folded
section of dark netting, protecting the pile
of mixed fish underneath. The wood is stained
dark from use.

name: LOW FISH CRATE
text: A wider, shallower crate sits on the floor,
holding a scattered layer of fish. The wood is
rough and practical, built for heavy lifting.

name: DARK WATER IN HATCH
text: The dark, murky water of the harbor sloshes
gently beneath the floorboards. It reflects
the dim light from the cabin above.

name: COIL OF THICK ROPE
text: A heavy coil of weathered rope lies on the
floor near the bed. The fibers are frayed from
constant use in the damp environment.

name: HANGING FISHING NET
text: A large section of dark netting is draped
against the wall, secured by wooden pegs. The
mesh looks strong enough to haul in a
substantial catch.

name: UPRIGHT CRATE OF FISH
text: This crate stands on its end, packed tight
with fish layered vertically. The silvery
bodies are crammed together against the wooden
slats.

name: WOODEN SHIP'S WHEEL
text: A classic wooden steering wheel is mounted
firmly near the window. The spokes are worn
smooth from the grip of many hands.

name: COILED HANGING ROPE
text: A neat loop of sturdy rope hangs from a peg on
the wall. It's ready to be grabbed at a
moment's notice for securing gear.
